RNGdle Terms of Use

Reviewed and updated by the RNGdle Editorial Team. 2026-07-26.

Entertainment use

RNGdle is provided as a browser game for entertainment. The numbers, badges, EP values, and rarity labels are game mechanics and should not be interpreted as gambling, financial advice, or a prediction system.

The static remake is designed for local play and may differ from the live RNGdle service.

Fair play

The daily roll is stored locally on the player's device. Clearing browser data can reset local progress, so local scores should be treated as personal play records rather than authoritative competition data.

Accounts are provided for sign-in convenience. Any future online leaderboard or server-verified score system would need separate server-side validation and updated terms.

Contact

Questions or reports can be sent to report@rngdle.com.
